I couldn't find an Alberta figure. The only Statistics Canada table on poverty by disability status is 11-10-0090-01, and it covers Canada only, with no provincial breakdown. Table 11-10-0087-01 does have provinces, but it measures income distribution, not poverty rates.

For Canada, the poverty rate for persons with disabilities aged 15 and over was 12.6% in 2024. That uses the Market Basket Measure, 2023 base. Persons without disabilities had a rate of 8.4%. The Canada estimates exclude the territories.

- **Persons with disabilities:** 12.6% in 2024 (v1793292452). The rate was 12.9% in 2022 and 12.8% in 2023.
- **Persons without disabilities:** 8.4% in 2024 (v1793292497). The rate was 7.7% in 2022 and 8.3% in 2023.

Source: Statistics Canada, Table 11-10-0090-01, Canadian Income Survey, reference years 2022–2024. The data quality rating is B (very good).

An Alberta estimate may exist in a custom tabulation or a Statistics Canada release that isn't in this dataset. I haven't checked those.
